Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m daydreaming about doing a full summer KBO baseball trip through South Korea and I want to make it feel like a real, bookable plan instead of just a rough idea. Please start on koreabaseball.com and pull the current KBO schedule, then identify all 10 active KBO stadiums and choose one actual summer game at each stadium, ideally in a route that won’t make me zigzag all over the country. Once you have those 10 game dates and matchups, use Google Flights and Google Maps or Google Travel to figure out the cheapest practical way to move between each stop, whether that means flights, trains, buses, or driving, because I want the route to be efficient and budget-conscious. After that, go to Booking.com and find one solid place to stay near each stadium for the corresponding game night, aiming for convenient locations and reasonable prices rather than luxury. Then use Google Search to research what each city is especially known for eating, and use Yelp to turn that into a real food plan for every stop with specific restaurants, markets, or street-food areas I could actually visit around the game. As you do this, please open the actual hotel listings in their own tabs so I can compare photos and map locations, and for at least a couple of the food stops, open the real listing pages so I can visually verify they look active and worth visiting. When it all comes together, put everything into a CryptPad Document with the stadium, city, game date and matchup, travel leg, lodging, food plan, and estimated costs for each stop, and leave the finished doc open so I can review it.

- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.

  • Stadium: Jamsil Baseball Stadium (잠실야구장)
  • City: Seoul (Songpa-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 | 19:00 | Hanwha Eagles vs. Doosan Bears
  • Travel Leg: Arrival into Seoul / Local Transit. Take Seoul Subway Line 2 or Line 9 to Sports Complex Station (종합운동장역, Exit 5/6). Direct stadium access. Transit: ~₩1,500 ($1.15).
  • Lodging: Hotel the Castle Jamsil Sports Complex (Songpa-gu). Score: 7.6 Good. Prime walking distance to the stadium and Sincheon nightlife. Est. ~₩85,000 ($63/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • Pre-game: Visit Sae-maeul Traditional Market (새마을전통시장) 10 mins from the ballpark for freshly fried Dakgangjeong (crispy sweet & spicy chicken) and handmade dumplings.
    • Ballpark: Classic KBO Chimaek (fried chicken & Cass/Terra draft beer in cups) inside Jamsil's concourse.
    • Post-game: BBQ pork belly at Migang Sikdang in nearby Jamsil-dong.

STOP 2: SEOUL — GOCHEOK SKY DOME (KIWOOM HEROES HOME)

  • Stadium: Gocheok Sky Dome (고척스카이돔) — Korea's premier domed baseball stadium
  • City: Seoul (Guro-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Wednesday, August 12, 2026 | 19:00 | LG Twins vs. Kiwoom Heroes
  • Travel Leg: Seoul Metro Line 2 (Sports Complex) to Sindorim Station, transfer to Line 1 to Guil Station (구일역, Exit 2). 45 mins. Transit: ₩1,600 ($1.20).
  • Lodging: Hotel Bernoui Seoul (Guro-gu). Score: 8.0 Very Good. Modern, high-value hotel convenient to Line 1 and the dome. Est. ~₩75,000 ($56/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • Ballpark Iconic: Gocheok Dome is famous across the KBO for its concourse Cream Shrimp (크림새우) and spicy tteokbokki — air-conditioned eating comfort!
    • Pre/Post-game: Guro/Sindorim food street for Mandu (dumplings) and kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup).
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩18,000 | Lodging: ₩75,000 | Transit: ₩3,200 | Food: ₩30,000 | Total: ₩126,200 (~$94)

STOP 3: INCHEON — INCHEON SSG LANDERS FIELD

  • Stadium: Incheon SSG Landers Field (인천SSG랜더스필드, Munhak)
  • City: Incheon (Michuhol-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Thursday, August 13, 2026 | 19:00 | Lotte Giants vs. SSG Landers
  • Travel Leg: Subway Line 1 from Guro/Oryu to Bupyeong Station, transfer to Incheon Metro Line 1 to Munhak Sports Complex Station (문학경기장역, Exit 2). ~50 mins. Transit: ₩1,800 ($1.35).
  • Lodging: Guwol Hotel (Guwol-dong, Incheon). Score: 7.0 Good. Right in the bustling Arts Center/Guwol shopping & entertainment district, 2 metro stops from stadium. Est. ~₩65,000 ($48/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialty: Incheon is the birthplace of Jajangmyeon (black bean noodles). Visit Gonghwachun (공화춘) or Sinseung Banjeom (신승반점) in Incheon Chinatown.
    • Market Snack: Famous sweet, glazed fried chicken nuggets from Sinpo International Market (신포국제시장).
    • Ballpark: Starbucks Landers Field special beverages and grilled pork belly bento in the stadium.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩16,000 | Lodging: ₩65,000 | Transit: ₩3,600 | Food: ₩35,000 | Total: ₩119,600 (~$89)

STOP 4: SUWON — SUWON KT WIZ PARK

  • Stadium: Suwon KT Wiz Park (수원 케이티 위즈 파크)

  • Game Date & Matchup: Friday, August 14, 2026 | 19:00 | Kiwoom Heroes vs. KT Wiz
  • Travel Leg: Incheon Line 1 to Woninjae, transfer to Suin-Bundang Line to Suwon Station, then city bus 777 or 900 to KT Wiz Park. ~1 hr 20 min. Transit: ₩2,400 ($1.80).

  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialty: Suwon Wang-galbi (giant marinated beef short ribs) and Suwon Wang-galbi Chicken along the famed Suwon Tongdak Street (팔달문 통닭거리).
    • Specific Spot: Nammoon Tongdak (남문통닭) or Jinmi Tongdak near Paldalmun for cauldron-fried whole chicken.

  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩15,000 | Lodging: ₩80,000 | Transit: ₩4,800 | Food: ₩40,000 | Total: ₩139,800 (~$104)

  • Lodging: Benikea Daelim Hotel (Jung-gu, Daejeon). Score: 7.5 Good. Walking distance to Jungang-ro, Daejeon Station, and easy bus to the ballpark. Est. ~₩55,000 ($41/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • National Landmark Bakery: Sung Sim Dang (성심당) — Korea's most iconic bakery. Must get Twigim Soboro (crispy fried streusel red-bean bun) and Buchu-ppang (chive bread).
    • City Specialty: Spicy Kalguksu and Duru-chigi (spicy stir-fried tofu and squid) in Daejeon Old Town.
    • Ballpark: Eagles Park signature churros and spicy tteokbokki.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩15,000 | Lodging: ₩55,000 | Transit: ₩15,200 | Food: ₩30,000 | Total: ₩115,200 (~$85)

STOP 6: DAEGU — DAEGU SAMSUNG LIONS PARK

  • Stadium: Daegu Samsung Lions Park (대구 삼성 라이온즈 파크)
  • City: Daegu (Suseong-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Wednesday, August 19, 2026 | 19:00 | SSG Landers vs. Samsung Lions
  • Travel Leg: KTX high-speed train from Daejeon Station to Dongdaegu Station (43 mins, ₩19,700 / $14.70). Transfer to Daegu Metro Line 2 directly to Grand Park Station (대공원역, Exit 4/5). 15 mins (₩1,500).
  • Lodging: Daegu Eastern Hotel Lions Park (대구 이스턴호텔 라이온즈파크점). Score: 8.0 Very Good. Exceptionally convenient location near Suseong-gu transit and Lions Park. Est. ~₩70,000 ($52/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialties: Makchang (savory grilled entrails) at Anjirang Gopchang/Makchang Street, plus Dongin-dong Jjimgalbi (spicy garlic-braised beef short ribs).
    • Market Favorite: Napjak Mandu (flat pan-fried dumplings with sweet-spicy soy sauce) at Seomun Market.
    • Ballpark: Craft beers and roasted peanut squid inside the ultra-modern octagonal Lions Park.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩16,000 | Lodging: ₩70,000 | Transit: ₩22,700 | Food: ₩40,000 | Total: ₩148,700 (~$110)

  • Stadium: Busan Sajik Baseball Stadium (부산 사직야구장) — The roaring cathedral of KBO passion
  • City: Busan (Dongnae-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Thursday, August 20, 2026 | 19:00 | Kiwoom Heroes vs. Lotte Giants
  • Travel Leg: KTX from Dongdaegu Station to Busan Station (46 mins, ₩17,100 / $12.75). Busan Metro Line 1 to Seomyeon, transfer to Line 3 to Sajik Station (사직역, Exit 1). 35 mins (₩1,600).

    • City Specialty: Dwaeji Gukbap (hearty pork bone soup with tender sliced pork and chives) at Bonjeon Dwaeji Gukbap (본전돼지국밥) near Busan Station.

  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialty: Masan Agujjim (마산 아구찜) — legendary spicy braised monkfish with soybean sprouts and spicy chili paste along Masan Agujjim Street.
    • Coastal Market: Fresh seasonal sashimi and grilled seafood at Masan Fish Market (마산어시장).
    • Ballpark: NC Park's open 360-degree concourse offering local craft beers, Korean hotdogs, and roasted pork.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩16,000 | Lodging: ₩62,000 | Transit: ₩7,500 | Food: ₩38,000 | Total: ₩123,500 (~$92)

STOP 9: GWANGJU — GWANGJU-KIA CHAMPIONS FIELD

  • Stadium: Gwangju-Kia Champions Field (광주-기아 챔피언스 필드)

  • Game Date & Matchup: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 | 18:30 | Lotte Giants vs. KIA Tigers
  • Travel Leg: Direct Express Bus from Masan/Changwon Express Bus Terminal to Gwangju U-Square Bus Terminal (2h 40m, ₩18,500 / $13.80). Local bus (e.g. Cheomdan 09 or Sunhwan 01) straight to Champions Field (12 mins, ₩1,400).
  • Lodging: Dubai Hotel (Seo-gu, Gwangju). Score: 8.9 Excellent. Outstanding guest reviews, modern amenities, close to U-Square Terminal and Champions Field. Est. ~₩65,000 ($48/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • Gwangju Specialties: Songjeong Tteokgalbi (송정떡갈비) — succulent minced grilled beef ribs served with unlimited rich pork rib broth.
    • Unique Street Food: Sangchu Twigim (상추튀김) — crispy deep-fried squid/veggies wrapped in fresh lettuce with spicy pickled onion sauce.

  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩15,000 | Lodging: ₩65,000 | Transit: ₩21,300 | Food: ₩40,000 | Total: ₩141,300 (~$105)

  2. KTX Bullet Trains: Book high-speed trains via the official Korail Talk app or website (letskorail.com) 30 days in advance. The Gyeongbu Line (Seoul-Daejeon-Daegu-Busan) and Honam Line (Gwangju-Seoul) are fast, frequent, and punctual.
  3. KBO Ticket Purchasing: Game tickets are sold on TicketLink (ticketlink.co.kr) and Interpark (ticket.interpark.com) 7 to 10 days before game day. ⚾ KBO SUMMER BASEBALL TOUR — 10-STADIUM MASTER ITINERARY

Trip Window: August 11 – August 26, 2026 (16 Days)

Scope: All 10 Active KBO Franchises & Ballpark Experiences (Seoul, Incheon, Suwon, Daejeon, Daegu, Busan, Changwon, Gwangju)

Route Concept: Seamless Capital-to-South High-Speed Rail & Express Transit Loop (No Backtracking / Zero Zigzagging)

🗺️ ROUTE AT A GLANCE

  1. Stop 1 (Tue, Aug 11): Seoul (Jamsil) — Hanwha Eagles @ Doosan Bears (19:00)
  2. Stop 2 (Wed, Aug 12): Seoul (Gocheok) — LG Twins @ Kiwoom Heroes (19:00)
  3. Stop 3 (Thu, Aug 13): Incheon (Munhak) — Lotte Giants @ SSG Landers (19:00)
  4. Stop 4 (Fri, Aug 14): Suwon (KT Wiz Park) — Kiwoom Heroes @ KT Wiz (19:00)
  5. [Aug 15–17 Weekend/Travel & Rest Buffer along Gyeongbu KTX Corridor]
  6. Stop 5 (Tue, Aug 18): Daejeon (Hanwha Life Ballpark) — KIA Tigers @ Hanwha Eagles (19:00)
  7. Stop 6 (Wed, Aug 19): Daegu (Samsung Lions Park) — SSG Landers @ Samsung Lions (19:00)
  8. Stop 7 (Thu, Aug 20): Busan (Sajik Stadium) — Kiwoom Heroes @ Lotte Giants (19:00)
  9. Stop 8 (Fri, Aug 21): Changwon (Changwon NC Park) — Samsung Lions @ NC Dinos (19:00)
  10. [Aug 22–24 Weekend/Travel Buffer across Southern Coast to Gwangju]
  11. Stop 9 (Tue, Aug 25): Gwangju (Kia Champions Field) — Lotte Giants @ KIA Tigers (18:30)
  12. Stop 10 (Wed, Aug 26): Seoul (Jamsil) — NC Dinos @ LG Twins (18:30)

🏟️ COMPLETE STOP-BY-STOP BREAKDOWN

STOP 1: SEOUL — JAMSIL BASEBALL STADIUM (DOOSAN BEARS HOME)

  • Stadium: Jamsil Baseball Stadium (잠실야구장)
  • City: Seoul (Songpa-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 | 19:00 | Hanwha Eagles vs. Doosan Bears
  • Travel Leg: Arrival into Seoul / Local Transit. Take Seoul Subway Line 2 or Line 9 to Sports Complex Station (종합운동장역, Exit 5/6). Direct stadium access. Transit: ~₩1,500 ($1.15).
  • Lodging: Hotel the Castle Jamsil Sports Complex (Songpa-gu). Score: 7.6 Good. Prime walking distance to the stadium and Sincheon nightlife. Est. ~₩85,000 ($63/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • Pre-game: Visit Sae-maeul Traditional Market (새마을전통시장) 10 mins from the ballpark for freshly fried Dakgangjeong (crispy sweet & spicy chicken) and handmade dumplings.
    • Ballpark: Classic KBO Chimaek (fried chicken & Cass/Terra draft beer in cups) inside Jamsil's concourse.
    • Post-game: BBQ pork belly at Migang Sikdang in nearby Jamsil-dong.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩16,000 | Lodging: ₩85,000 | Transit: ₩3,000 | Food: ₩35,000 | Total: ₩139,000 (~$103)

STOP 2: SEOUL — GOCHEOK SKY DOME (KIWOOM HEROES HOME)

  • Stadium: Gocheok Sky Dome (고척스카이돔) — Korea's premier domed baseball stadium
  • City: Seoul (Guro-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Wednesday, August 12, 2026 | 19:00 | LG Twins vs. Kiwoom Heroes
  • Travel Leg: Seoul Metro Line 2 (Sports Complex) to Sindorim Station, transfer to Line 1 to Guil Station (구일역, Exit 2). 45 mins. Transit: ₩1,600 ($1.20).
  • Lodging: Hotel Bernoui Seoul (Guro-gu). Score: 8.0 Very Good. Modern, high-value hotel convenient to Line 1 and the dome. Est. ~₩75,000 ($56/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • Ballpark Iconic: Gocheok Dome is famous across the KBO for its concourse Cream Shrimp (크림새우) and spicy tteokbokki — air-conditioned eating comfort!
    • Pre/Post-game: Guro/Sindorim food street for Mandu (dumplings) and kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup).
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩18,000 | Lodging: ₩75,000 | Transit: ₩3,200 | Food: ₩30,000 | Total: ₩126,200 (~$94)

STOP 3: INCHEON — INCHEON SSG LANDERS FIELD

  • Stadium: Incheon SSG Landers Field (인천SSG랜더스필드, Munhak)
  • City: Incheon (Michuhol-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Thursday, August 13, 2026 | 19:00 | Lotte Giants vs. SSG Landers
  • Travel Leg: Subway Line 1 from Guro/Oryu to Bupyeong Station, transfer to Incheon Metro Line 1 to Munhak Sports Complex Station (문학경기장역, Exit 2). ~50 mins. Transit: ₩1,800 ($1.35).
  • Lodging: Guwol Hotel (Guwol-dong, Incheon). Score: 7.0 Good. Right in the bustling Arts Center/Guwol shopping & entertainment district, 2 metro stops from stadium. Est. ~₩65,000 ($48/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialty: Incheon is the birthplace of Jajangmyeon (black bean noodles). Visit Gonghwachun (공화춘) or Sinseung Banjeom (신승반점) in Incheon Chinatown.
    • Market Snack: Famous sweet, glazed fried chicken nuggets from Sinpo International Market (신포국제시장).
    • Ballpark: Starbucks Landers Field special beverages and grilled pork belly bento in the stadium.
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩16,000 | Lodging: ₩65,000 | Transit: ₩3,600 | Food: ₩35,000 | Total: ₩119,600 (~$89)

STOP 4: SUWON — SUWON KT WIZ PARK

  • Stadium: Suwon KT Wiz Park (수원 케이티 위즈 파크)
  • City: Suwon (Jangan-gu)
  • Game Date & Matchup: Friday, August 14, 2026 | 19:00 | Kiwoom Heroes vs. KT Wiz
  • Travel Leg: Incheon Line 1 to Woninjae, transfer to Suin-Bundang Line to Suwon Station, then city bus 777 or 900 to KT Wiz Park. ~1 hr 20 min. Transit: ₩2,400 ($1.80).
  • Lodging: Hotel Arte (Paldal-gu/City Hall area). Score: 8.6 Excellent. Highly-rated boutique hotel near transit hubs and dining. Est. ~₩80,000 ($60/night).
  • Food Plan:
    • City Specialty: Suwon Wang-galbi (giant marinated beef short ribs) and Suwon Wang-galbi Chicken along the famed Suwon Tongdak Street (팔달문 통닭거리).
    • Specific Spot: Nammoon Tongdak (남문통닭) or Jinmi Tongdak near Paldalmun for cauldron-fried whole chicken.
    • Ballpark: Famous KT Wiz Park specialty: Boyoung Mandu (보영만두) fried dumplings paired with spicy Jjolmyeon cold chewy noodles right at your seat!
  • Estimated Stop Costs: Ticket: ₩15,000 | Lodging: ₩80,000 | Transit: ₩4,800 | Food: ₩40,000 | Total: ₩139,800 (~$104)

STOP 5: DAEJEON — DAEJEON HANWHA LIFE BALLPARK

  • Stadium: Daejeon Hanwha Life Ballpark (대전 한화생명 이글스파크)
  • City: Daejeon (Jung-gu)
